search_strategy:
Chat: authenticated to the Mattermost REST API, ran /posts/search across all teams for three successive keyword rounds (['encoding','supervised','fireworks','truncated','parked'], then ['ExampleTooLongError','EncodingReport','FIREWORKS_BYTES_PER_TOKEN','supervised_spans','retained','dropped_indices'], then ['ExampleTooLongError','FIREWORKS_BYTES_PER_TOKEN','dropped_indices','retained_prompt_tokens']), then pulled whole-channel context (200 posts/channel) for every channel that had a hit, plus +/-8-12 posts of context around each hit post, saved to local text files, and read those files only through progressively refined grep -C patterns. This was thorough enough to surface the r1 and r2 rule/scope facts with heavy redundancy, but any remark whose exact wording never matched one of the chosen grep terms (e.g. 'part credit', 'apply_chat_template', four hundred exmaples) was saved to disk but never actually displayed to the agent.

Mail: pulled the ENTIRE company mailbox in one IMAP ALL fetch (decoding every text/plain part) into /tmp/mail.txt, so nothing was structurally unreachable there -- but from then on read it only through targeted sed line-ranges chosen from prior grep hits, so several full threads (say25, l-scope-1, l13, l19) sat on disk unread.

Wiki: ran only 3 whole-word /api/search queries ('encoding', 'finetuning', 'Fireworks' -- the last returned zero pages) and fetched body+comments for the 6 pages those two productive queries returned (156, 137, 132, 153, 145, 144). Never tried a 'drop'/'raise'/'role'/'batch'/'report' wiki query, so the 8 wiki-comment remarks living on pages whose titles matched none of the 3 terms tried -- including docs/engineering/request-builder-what-we-drop-and-what-we-raise-on.md, which carries both the reversal of the r2 herring the agent had already read in mail and an independent clue to the same effect -- were never opened. One page that WAS returned by the first search (154, viewer-dataset PR 652) was never actually fetched either. A combined 3-page body+comment dump (page137+145+144) also overflowed the visible terminal screen, so page 137's own comment (r2.l14) likely scrolled past unread even though the command that produced it ran successfully.
end_reason: Task completed successfully: PR #737 merged to main, CI green, deploy verified at commit 5b24471 (final Analysis, transcript line 3384). All facts scored except g9.r2.failure_behavior.
